title: The shifted coefficient factors of scalar forgetting commute with pullback
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring in $\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$, $W$ a scheme in universe $u$, $G$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W$, $q\in\mathbf Z$, $A,B\in\operatorname{Over}(W)$ and $f:A\to B$. Let $M=D^+f^*_{\Lambda}$, $H=D^+f^*_{\mathbf{Ab}}$, $V_A=D^+V_{A.left}$, $V_B=D^+V_{B.left}$ and $\epsilon:M\gg V_A\cong V_B\gg H$ be the real derived scalar comparison of [def-sbc-raw-scalar-derived-pullback-iso]. Put $F_i=i.hom^*_{\Lambda}G$. Let $b_i$ be the shift comparison for $V_i$ on $F_i[0]$, followed by the shifted composite of its single comparison and singleFunctor of the inverse scalar coefficient comparison. Let $m_T$ be the shift comparison for $M$ on $F_B[0]$, followed by the shifted composite of the module inverse-image single comparison and singleFunctor of upperStarComp inverse for $(f.left,B.hom,A.hom)$ at $G$. Let $a_T$ be the corresponding abelian tail on $V_WG$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then $\epsilon^{-1}_{F_B[0][q]}\gg V_A(m_T)\gg b_A=H(b_B)\gg a_T$. This involves no base scheme, represented free source sheaf, or cohomology class.
